overview: VYAN Netra is a unified admin console for the VYAN Labs ecosystem. It brings all your apps, websites, and platforms under one command center — connected via unique 6-digit registration codes. Monitor system health in real time, manage users across products, track issues, control notifications, and oversee updates and emails — all from a single dark, cosmic-themed interface built for VYAN's AI Void aesthetic.
features: Unified user management across all connected products
Real-time system monitoring agent (CPU, memory, disk, API, network)
Notifications and alerts center with severity levels
Issue and incident management with comment threads
Updates and changelog management with deployment scheduling
Email control panel with template library
Cosmic AI void theme with nano-particle animated orbs and glass morphism
